description: Three of the four Eventing worked-example pages demonstrating an inline N1QL()/query call correctly call results.close() to free the streamed cursor (basicN1qlSelectStmt.md, basicN1qlPreparedSelectStmt.md, advancedSelfRecursion.md). eventing-handler-docControlledSelfExpiry.md calls N1QL(stmt) and never captures a return value or closes anything. Plausibly a legitimate exception - a bare UPDATE with no rows to iterate may not return a closeable cursor - but no page states this, and the page sits in the same batch as three siblings that do close it, so a reader has no way to tell an omission from a rule.
